connect.title: Wallet Passport
connect.valueProp: A transparent TON passport for your wallet: age, activity and reputation — built from on-chain history, no manual input.
connect.testnetHint: Mainnet is not used until explicitly enabled.

scan.title: Scan Wallet
scan.body: Starts history collection and Wallet Score calculation.

reveal.title: Profile / Reveal
reveal.body: Shows the final Score, strongest factors, and transparent wallet metrics.

mint.title: Mint SBT
mint.body: Sends a TonConnect transaction with the backend-signed permit unchanged.

scanning.title: Analyzing your wallet
scanning.subtitle: This takes 1-2 minutes — we're reconstructing your full on-chain history.

summary.steady: This wallet is led by {{primary}} and {{secondary}}. A {{score}} score points to a steady history without sharp imbalance.
summary.flow: The wallet stands out through {{primary}} and {{secondary}}: movement, counterparties, and economic activity are the main signal.
summary.explore: {{primary}} and {{secondary}} dominate. This profile looks like an ecosystem user across tokens, collections, and protocols.
summary.craft: The leading factors are {{primary}} and {{secondary}}. The profile reads as a technical or infrastructure footprint on TON.
summary.balanced: The factors are evenly spread. A {{score}} score is built from several activity directions, with no single dominant signal.

referral.title: Referrals
referral.connectToGet: Connect your wallet to receive a referral link

info.title: How referrals work
info.body: A referral link tracks the invited user's Wallet Passport path: app open, wallet connection, and first scan.

inviter.title: For the inviter
inviter.body: Your profile prepares invited, connected, and scanned credits: who joined through your link, connected a wallet, and completed a scan.

invited.title: For the invited user
invited.body: The invited user lands directly in the Mini App flow and can connect a wallet without entering a code.

scanned.title: When a scan counts
scanned.body: A scan counts only after wallet analysis finishes. Later passport refreshes can be tracked separately.

info.reputationNote: Referrals do not farm Score: they do not change reputation, Passport categories, or NFT rarity.
